hero.headline: Launch your online store on a platform built for it
hero.subheadline: Pick a professional theme, connect your payments and shipping, and start selling — each store fully isolated on its own secure tenant.

features.title: Everything a store needs, none of the infrastructure

security.title: Secure by design
security.description: Every store runs on its own isolated tenant, enforced at the database level — your data never mixes with anyone else's.

commerce.title: Real inventory & orders
commerce.description: Track stock across locations and manage the full order lifecycle from a single dashboard.

payments.title: Built-in payments & shipping
payments.description: Configure how your customers pay and how orders ship, with a provider system designed to grow with you.

bilingual.title: Bilingual from day one
bilingual.description: Every storefront ships in Arabic and English, right-to-left included.

step1.title: Choose your theme
step1.description: Browse ready-made storefront designs and preview them before you commit.

step2.title: Subscribe to a plan
step2.description: Pick the plan that fits your business — upgrade anytime as you grow.

step3.title: Add your products
step3.description: Bring in your catalog, set your prices, and configure shipping and payments.

step4.title: Go live
step4.description: Your store gets its own address instantly — no servers, no setup, no code.
